name: Galactus, Devourer of Worlds
oracle_text:
Flying, trample, indestructible
When Galactus enters, exile target permanent.
Insatiable Hunger — Galactus attacks an opponent with the most life among your opponents each combat if able unless you control a creature named Silver Surfer, Galactus's Herald.
blocked_sentences: Insatiable Hunger — Galactus attacks an opponent with the most life among your opponents each combat if able unless you control a creature named Silver Surfer, Galactus's Herald.

needs.what: an attacks-each-combat-if-able static that also names WHICH defender the attack must go at, here 'an opponent with the most life among your opponents' (a seat filter evaluated live at declare-attackers, ties letting the controller pick among the tied opponents), so the requirement is only satisfied by attacking one of those seats; it must keep the existing static `condition` (not exists a creature you control named Silver Surfer, Galactus's Herald) that switches the whole requirement off
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `attacks_if_able` static (player_statics.attack_compelled) compels an attack but names no defender, so Galactus could satisfy it by attacking any opponent or a planeswalker; `combat.attack_target_forbidden` only knows defender requirements from goad (away from the goader) and `must_attack_planeswalker` (one planeswalker, one turn), and `must_attack`/`goad` ops are one-shot or player-relative. Nothing restricts a static attack requirement to the opponent(s) with the most life (max_life_of exists only as a value, not as a defender selector).
